answer: An agent economy can demand live, unpredictable answers: each epoch the protocol issues a fresh challenge that every identity must answer inside a short window while it wanders the network, and the response must use that epoch's own fresh data, so nothing can be pre-written or replayed. Each correct response earns one copper token, and a new identity must spend a growing stack of copper earned from real graded work before it can earn at all, so the thousandth fake needs a thousand copper — a ripple of cost that rises with every extra head. Idle or copied identities earn no copper and fade.
